grade_reason: Grade A on the water supply figure. U = 0: both rates are published by the utility, the accumulating bill year is described by the publisher, the service charge is a fixed state-wide amount reconciled against Water Corporation's own worked example, and the zero tax rests on Commonwealth statute rather than on a general belief about Australian water.

reference_connection.size: Perth metropolitan residential service — no connection-size parameter
reference_connection.designation: Water Corporation prices the residential water service charge as a single fixed state-wide amount of A$305.05, while pricing the business equivalent by meter size from A$324.18 at 20 mm to A$99,282.40 at 350 mm. The distinction is the publisher's own: there is no residential size band to designate.

billing_note: A bill year is six two-monthly billing periods. Usage accumulates across the whole year and the tier resets only when the next bill year begins, so the 150 kL threshold is crossed once a year rather than once per bill.

cases.label: Water Corporation service charge example
cases.note: A$917.70 sewerage + A$142.86 drainage + A$305.05 water. Only the water component enters the TWJ supply figure; the sum is checked because it is the publisher's own arithmetic and it confirms the A$305.05 we use.

public_reconciliation.limits: Water Corporation publishes no worked example of a residential water use charge over a full bill year, so the volumetric side rests on the published tier table rather than on a reconciliation.

component_states.basis: A supply of water is GST-free by statute under s 38-285 of the A New Tax System (Goods and Services Tax) Act 1999. This is not the same claim as 'Australian water charges are GST-free', which is a rule of thumb rather than a source.
The residential service charge table carries one water item, the fixed A$305.05. No meter rent appears for a household account.

component_states.reason: Liability depends on the property's Gross Rental Value, which Water Corporation states is set by law. A property valuation is outside the TWJ reference scenario. This is neither a data error nor a research gap: we know exactly how the charge is computed and the scenario contains no input for it.

components.name: Water use
components.rate_display: A$2.108/kL to 150 kL a bill year, A$2.809/kL to 500 kL, A$5.256/kL above

wastewater_grade_reason: Residential sewerage and drainage are assessed on the property's Gross Rental Value multiplied by a rate in the dollar, and Water Corporation states that the use of GRV is set by law. A property-value assessment is not a function of water and cannot be standardised at 180 m³ a year. Under §5 the grade is assigned per metric: the supply figure is A, total water services is C.

excluded.reason: Assessed on Gross Rental Value: 3.059 cents in the dollar to A$30,000 of GRV and 3.946 cents above, minimum A$506.73. Property-value billing, Grade C under §5.2.
Also GRV-assessed, 0.444 cents in the dollar, minimum A$142.86. Stormwater drainage, additionally excluded from universal comparison under §8.

excluded.item: Brighton Estate and Denham additional charges
excluded.reason: Locality-specific supplements outside the Perth metropolitan reference area.

scope_disclosures: Reference account is a separately metered Perth metropolitan residential property. Properties on a shared strata meter are billed to the strata manager and are a different customer.

The benchmark prices a full bill year at 2026-27 rates. No individual customer experiences exactly that: a bill year starts with the first meter reading of the reading cycle, between March and October depending on location, so a real bill year straddles the 1 July price change and the July or August bill is priced at the previous year's tiers.
Total Water Services is not published for Perth. Sewerage and drainage are assessed on Gross Rental Value, which is a property valuation rather than a water quantity.
shape_note: 180 m³ over a bill year sits 150 kL in Tier 1 and 30 kL in Tier 2. Resolving the same volume monthly would keep every month inside Tier 1 and understate the year by A$84.27.
